cautions: The target is advertised asking price in KZT, not a verified transaction value.

Historical test errors motivated earlier feature-engineering hypotheses. This cleanup preserves the previously selected recipe. Training CV and validation control fitting/checkpoints; there is no new blend search or test-based acceptance. This reused test is retrospective and cannot establish independent generalization.
The nine systems share validation and historical-test IDs but use different feature representations; this is not an isolated algorithm effect.
PCA retained variance concerns three numeric input features, not price variance or prediction accuracy.
PCA and KMeans use 1,775 non-electric training listings; 12 electric training rows are excluded only from this geometry, not from supervised evaluation.
Price and categorical fields are outside PCA/KMeans fitting. Cluster labels are exploratory geometric groups, not established natural market segments.
PCA loadings are signed unit component directions, not feature-component correlations. Component signs are arbitrary.
The cockpit, HUD and Porsche are presentation imagery and do not represent a particular study observation or live vehicle valuation.
